comparison_to_subagent_baseline: Subagent baseline caught 5 defects (1 major). Team arm caught the same 5 lane defects (1 major, D-A1) PLUS 1 infrastructure defect (D-TEAM-1) that the subagent arm structurally could not surface, because subagents have no TaskCreated/TeammateIdle team lifecycle to exercise the governance hooks.

defects.finding: A declared gate whose script file is missing emits 'SKIP|<name>|script_not_found|0' and returns 0, so a deleted/renamed blocking gate silently never runs and never fails the phase (Joan NF-1 failure mode, currently exploitable). WO-127's executed-vs-declared gate is the defense.

validate-audit-completeness.sh is registered advisory (blocking:false, env {}) so ENFORCE_AUDIT_LOOP defaults false; it exits 0 even when completed WOs miss every audit checkpoint — a prose linter, not an artifact verifier. WO-127's auditor-artifact gate should be registered blocking.
waiver_check is stubbed 'deferred_until_WO-127'; the implementing WO must flip it to the real validate-waiver-expiry.sh invocation or the night-loop keeps skipping waiver expiry.

FILE-INVENTORY.md lists product-pyramid docs that do not exist in this meta/framework repo (expected — they are created downstream). Concrete reason WO-128's pyramid root + enforcement tier must be configurable and advisory-by-default. Not a plugin defect.

defects.location: doc-budget interaction with WO file growth
defects.finding: 136 of 154 governed md are docs/planning/WO-*.md; a naive doc-budget trips on normal WO accumulation. Spec resolves it by defaulting doc_budget.exclude_globs to exclude docs/planning/WO-*.md. Design caution that prevents a false-positive gate.

The WO-117 team-governance hook is registered for event names TaskCreated / TaskCompleted / TeammateIdle, but the Claude Code agent-teams runtime in this build does not emit those hook events. The hook never executed: .vibeos/team-governance/ was never created and events.jsonl is empty. Consequence: the WO-citation veto (TaskCreated/TaskCompleted) and the stall-detection log (TeammateIdle) are both inert. The pilot's entire governed-observability premise depends on this wiring. Remediation: confirm the exact team-lifecycle hook event names this Claude Code build emits (if any) and re-bind team-governance.sh to them, or implement the governance as a lead-side discipline + message-channel monitor. UNIQUE TO THE TEAM ARM — the subagent baseline could not have surfaced it.
